items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: He said, Well let me, let me go up here and play this Don Hooper used to call it. He didn't call it the calliope he said.

ctx.x: Can you tell us anything about Steve Lewis since he's not living to talk to us? Can you tell us anything how he played or how was he on calliope?

Everybody enjoyed Steve Lewis' calliope playing. He played a, he played a, he plays a jazzy piano you know. And he played the calliope the same way he played the piano. Like he was like jazz music up on that calliope. The captain used to laugh every time he finished. But Steve didn't like that idea of playing up there. He said with that cotton in his ear and all that steam coming on him. Every time it's time for him to go think he said, Well let me, let me go up here and play this Don Hooper used to call it. He…
When did they play the calliope? Just before the boat would sail or how did they do that?
